8.3.7 SecOC_TpCancelTransmit
[SWS_SecOC_91009]⌈
Service Name
SecOC_TpCancelTransmit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType SecOC_TpCancelTransmit (
PduIdType TxPduId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x54
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.
Parameters (in)
TxPduId
Identification of the PDU to be cancelled.
Parameters
(inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_Return-
Type
E_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the
destination module.
E_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination
module.
Description
Requests cancellation of an ongoing transmission of a PDU in a lower layer
communication module.
Available via
SecOC.h
⌋(SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00357, SRS_BSW_00449, SRS_SecOC_00012)
